shortDescription: Nine Energy Service AMEX:NINE fell 4.2% in Monday's trading after saying it agreed to acquire American Cementing from Argonaut Private Equity for 3.93M common shares and $7M in cash, expanding the company's cementing operations and presence in the Rockies, Bakken, and Northeast regions of the U.S.T…

children: fell 4.2% in Monday's trading after saying it agreed to

American Cementing from Argonaut Private Equity for 3.93M common shares and $7M in cash, expanding the company's cementing operations and presence in the Rockies, Bakken, and Northeast regions of the U.S.
The shares to be issued are expected to represent ~22% of Nine Energy's
outstanding common stock immediately following the closing of the transaction.

The company said it expects the acquisition to boost revenue by more than 35%, adding ~$200M in annual revenue, and has identified $2M-$5M of annual synergies expected in 2027, with additional upside potential as the businesses are integrated.
Argonaut CEO Steve Mitchell is expected to join Nine Energy's
board upon completion of the acquisition.

"American Cementing is a premier operator with a strong reputation, an outstanding team, and a footprint that fits well with ours. The acquisition will give us the scale and geographic reach to serve customers across more of the key U.S. basins," Nine Energy
President and CEO Ann Fox said.

title: Nine Energy Service to buy American Cementing in cash-and-stock deal
